name: Unbrowse
description: Websites as APIs: Unbrowse's hosted tools (discover, run, scrape, cloud browser, saved logins) plus a web_fetch provider; replaces the built-in browser for web pages.

apiKey.label: Unbrowse API key
apiKey.help: ub_live_… key from https://unbrowse.ai (fallback: UNBROWSE_API_KEY env var).

mcpUrl.label: Unbrowse MCP URL
mcpUrl.help: Hosted remote MCP endpoint (fallback: UNBROWSE_MCP_URL, then https://unbrowse.ai/mcp).

endUser.label: End user
endUser.help: Org keys only: the end user calls are made for (fallback: UNBROWSE_END_USER).

replaceBrowser.label: Replace the built-in browser
replaceBrowser.help: Block the browser tool for non-local URLs and point the agent at the Unbrowse tools.

blockWebFetch.label: Replace web_fetch
blockWebFetch.help: Also block web_fetch for non-local URLs in favour of unbrowse_scrape.
